mapper.select: SELECT SITU_NO AS situNo, SITU_TYPE AS situType, DNGR_TYPE AS dngrType, DNGR_LEVEL AS dngrLevel, SITU_STATUS AS situStatus, SITU_CONTENT AS situContent, SITU_LAT AS situLat, SITU_LON AS situLon, SITU_DATE AS situDate, WORK_CONTENT AS workContent, CHECK_DATE AS checkDate, START_DATE AS startDate, END_DATE AS endDate, ZONE_NAME AS zoneName, USER_ID AS userId, SITU_IMAGE AS situImage FROM SITUATIONS WHERE SITU_NO = #{situNo}

SELECT SITU_NO AS situNo, SITU_TYPE AS situType, DNGR_TYPE AS dngrType, DNGR_LEVEL AS dngrLevel, SITU_STATUS AS situStatus, SITU_CONTENT AS situContent, SITU_LAT AS situLat, SITU_LON AS situLon, SITU_DATE AS situDate, WORK_CONTENT AS workContent, CHECK_DATE AS checkDate, START_DATE AS startDate, END_DATE AS endDate, ZONE_NAME AS zoneName, USER_ID AS userId, SITU_IMAGE AS situImage FROM SITUATIONS ORDER BY SITU_NO DESC

SELECT SITU_NO AS situNo, SITU_TYPE AS situType, DNGR_TYPE AS dngrType, DNGR_LEVEL AS dngrLevel, SITU_STATUS AS situStatus, SITU_CONTENT AS situContent, SITU_LAT AS situLat, SITU_LON AS situLon, SITU_DATE AS situDate, WORK_CONTENT AS workContent, CHECK_DATE AS checkDate, START_DATE AS startDate, END_DATE AS endDate, ZONE_NAME AS zoneName, USER_ID AS userId, SITU_IMAGE AS situImage FROM SITUATIONS WHERE SITU_STATUS = '대기' ORDER BY SITU_DATE DESC

SELECT SITU_NO AS situNo, SITU_TYPE AS situType, DNGR_TYPE AS dngrType, DNGR_LEVEL AS dngrLevel, SITU_STATUS AS situStatus, SITU_CONTENT AS situContent, SITU_LAT AS situLat, SITU_LON AS situLon, SITU_DATE AS situDate, WORK_CONTENT AS workContent, CHECK_DATE AS checkDate, START_DATE AS startDate, END_DATE AS endDate, ZONE_NAME AS zoneName, USER_ID AS userId, SITU_IMAGE AS situImage FROM SITUATIONS WHERE START_DATE IS NOT NULL AND END_DATE IS NULL ORDER BY START_DATE DESC

SELECT SITU_NO AS situNo, SITU_TYPE AS situType, DNGR_TYPE AS dngrType, DNGR_LEVEL AS dngrLevel, SITU_STATUS AS situStatus, SITU_CONTENT AS situContent, SITU_LAT AS situLat, SITU_LON AS situLon, SITU_DATE AS situDate, WORK_CONTENT AS workContent, CHECK_DATE AS checkDate, START_DATE AS startDate, END_DATE AS endDate, ZONE_NAME AS zoneName, USER_ID AS userId, SITU_IMAGE AS situImage FROM SITUATIONS WHERE END_DATE IS NOT NULL ORDER BY END_DATE DESC
mapper.insert:
SELECT 'SITU_' || TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') || '_' || LPAD(SITU_SEQ.NEXTVAL, 4, '0') FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO SITUATIONS ( SITU_NO, SITU_TYPE, DNGR_TYPE, DNGR_LEVEL, SITU_CONTENT, SITU_LAT, SITU_LON, WORK_CONTENT, ZONE_NAME, USER_ID, SITU_IMAGE ) VALUES ( #{situNo}, #{situType}, #{dngrType}, #{dngrLevel}, #{situContent}, #{situLat, jdbcType=DOUBLE}, #{situLon, jdbcType=DOUBLE}, #{workContent, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{zoneName, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{userId}, #{situImage, jdbcType=VARCHAR} )
mapper.update: UPDATE SITUATIONS SET DNGR_TYPE = #{dngrType}, DNGR_LEVEL = #{dngrLevel}, SITU_STATUS = #{situStatus}, SITU_CONTENT = #{situContent}, WORK_CONTENT = #{workContent, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, SITU_IMAGE = #{situImage, jdbcType=VARCHAR} WHERE SITU_NO = #{situNo}
